description: Replace the little geometric fire cones inside the mask with natural LOW VOLUMETRIC painterly flame tongues emerging continuously from the existing orange burning bands. Keep each root broad and flat; soft irregular body with short uneven curling/forked tips, warm orange glow and smaller luminous inner strokes, translucent darker orange edges. Each patch is wider than tall, only15-22px high, never a tall jet. All six patches differ naturally, not identical cones or sawtooth bars. Match the fine mottled hand-painted texture of this tile, not flat vector symbols or hard geometric mountains. Some low tips spill over the two upper side rims. The original dark stone and cracks stay fixed; blend roots into the existing horizontal fire strokes. No detached sparks, smoke, extra objects, borders, captions, bright flash or pixel grid enlargement. This is a static medium-high key pose of steady calm burning, not ignition.
